core_reframe: A closed loop only buys ablation surfaces; it does not buy discrimination. The fair legal-channel baseline for an integrated loop is the INTEGRATED CACHE family, which must be beaten on a cache-void compositional held-out. Discrimination comes from env+schema+held-out structure, not from closing the loop.

inherited_contracts.DISTRIBUTION-HEADROOM-PREFLIGHT-CONTRACT: saturation STOP-gate: strongest_fair_legal_channel_baseline < ceiling - equivalence_band, applied with the integrated-cache family as that baseline
inherited_contracts.LEARNING-SUCCESS-CRITERION-STANDARD-001A: control vs rival; reducibility control (online must beat batch precompute); held-out novelty / few-shot / breadth-over-peak; genuine-learning signature
inherited_contracts.MECHANISM-SIGNATURE-VERDICT-STANDARD-001: S1 control-separation non-negotiable; verdict by signature not absolute score

formal_object.M: memory = (episodic trace E, consolidated store C)
formal_object.prediction: pred_t = P_theta(s_t, a_t) action-conditioned, no future info
formal_object.update: s_{t+1} = U_theta(s_t,o_t,a_t,outcome_t,PE_t); memory_write appends to E; C <- Consolidate_theta(E,C); s may update by replaying C offline
formal_object.objective_V: performance on HELD-OUT compositional behavior (novel factor combinations), not seen-state accuracy
formal_object.boundary: agent-controlled {a_t,s_t,M,theta} vs env {o_t,outcome_t}; self-boundary = posterior over action-caused outcome-variance, TESTED LAST, not built or claimed here
formal_object.same_agent_label_ceiling: one persistent hash-chained state with causal replay effect; NOT unified subject/self/agency

integrated_baseline_family_frozen.tie_rule: a tie with ANY member = baseline equivalence = route downgrade, NOT mechanism evidence

requirements.R1_cache_void_heldout: held-out = compositions with no correct cache entry; per item nearest/count/traversal answer provably <= chance
requirements.R2_causal_routing_ablation: corrupted-replay AND no-replay both destroy held-out gain; NECESSARY NOT SUFFICIENT (cache passes it too)
requirements.R3_integrated_baseline_family: mechanism must beat max over BOTH sub-families under equal data/access
requirements.R4_on_paper_cache_cannot_match: before code: (a) cache subfamily provably <= chance on R1 held-out; (b) name the specific sparse/non-stationary regime where offline consolidation could beat the learning subfamily. (b) is OPEN; likely outcome = baseline equivalence. Proceed only if (a) holds AND (b) names a testable regime, else STOP
requirements.R5_schema_anti_leakage: no baked-in answer: no self-label, no target-encoding field, no label-leaking action/observation names
requirements.R6_reducibility_non_experience_replay_co: consolidation must (i) beat vanilla experience replay, (ii) beat batch-precompute on same data; else 're-derived experience replay' downgrade; plus non-memorization (held-out not epsilon-close to trained)

honest_prior.H_null_LIKELY: a strong learning-subfamily member (continual-replay/meta-learner) matches the kernel -> baseline equivalence -> valid negative
honest_prior.H_target_UNLIKELY: a sparse/non-stationary regime where offline consolidation extracts a transferable schema that online+vanilla-replay+cache all miss
honest_prior.design_directive: design to DETECT which holds, not toward H_target

decision_table.verdict: STOP/redesign env; do NOT build kernel

decision_table.cond: R4(a) holds, R4(b) names no testable regime
decision_table.verdict: DOWNGRADE to auditable engineering demo; infrastructure claim only, not mechanism

decision_table.cond: R4(a) holds AND R4(b) names testable regime
decision_table.verdict: PROCEED to draft kernel STEP-A; must then empirically satisfy R2/R3/R6

decision_table.cond: kernel STEP-B ties any learning-subfamily member
decision_table.verdict: baseline equivalence = valid negative; route closes (expected H_null)

acceptance_gate_this_card: formal object + R1-R6 consistent; both baseline sub-families frozen; R4 argument drafted and falsifiable; H_null prior recorded; contracts cited; NO code, NO scoring, NO result.json
known_limitation: under 2026-07-05C solo protocol Claude is BOTH red-first designer and hostile auditor (relaxes DISTRIBUTION-HEADROOM role separation). Compensating: R4 is falsifiable at STEP-B + commit-order pre-registration. Not a full substitute; treat R4 as a hypothesis to break at STEP-B.
claim_ceiling: design + pre-registration only; cannot show kernel success, mechanism validity, learning, agency, self, emotion, consciousness, or EGO readiness. Passing authorizes only DRAFTING the kernel STEP-A card.
feeds: SAME-AGENT-MINIMAL-KERNEL-BRIDGE-001A STEP-A must cite this id, satisfy R1-R6, carry the R4 argument for its concrete env before any build.
